largest_evidenced_gap: The constructor and public schema validate local field shapes but do not close the relationships that give component lineage, bitemporal order, experiment completion, and proof levels their meaning. Internally contradictory views therefore receive a deterministic content hash and can report runtime_verified or deployed_verified.

fractional_valid_from_after_valid_until.cause: timestamps are compared lexicographically even though optional fractional seconds do not sort chronologically against the no-fraction Z form

reversed_timeline_transaction_time.mutation: sequence 0 transaction_time is later than sequence 1 transaction_time
reversed_timeline_transaction_time.cause: timeline sequence is checked but transaction_time ordering is not

cross_lineage_parent.mutation: child parent exists but logical_identity differs from parent
cross_lineage_parent.cause: parent existence is checked without logical identity, surface, generation, or transaction-time lineage joins

target_surface_component_mismatch.mutation: experiment targets prompt component while target_surface_ids contains router
target_surface_component_mismatch.cause: target component identities and target surfaces are validated independently

verified_unapplied_without_verification_.cause: verified_unapplied has no required verification receipt class

not_asserted_causality_with_receipt.cause: only verified causality requires a receipt; lower causality states may carry the same undifferentiated receipt field

runtime_applied_while_all_arms_planned.expected: rejected_until_exact arm results and verified decision exist
runtime_applied_while_all_arms_planned.cause: experiment plan/proof state is not joined to arm execution and result receipts

global_deployed_with_runtime_only_experi.cause: global deployed proof accepts an experiment whose proof level is only runtime_verified

rolled_back_without_applied_receipt.expected: rollback history binds both application and rollback receipts
rolled_back_without_applied_receipt.cause: rolled_back requires a rollback receipt but the schema and constructor require applied_receipt_sha256 to be null

details: The schema validates individual timestamps but cannot enforce chronological interval or timeline ordering.
Parent, target-component, and target-surface arrays are locally valid but not cross-bound.
Runtime/deployed allOf uses contains with runtime_verified or deployed_verified, so a runtime-only experiment can satisfy global deployed_verified.
Experiment proof and plan states are not conditioned on all three arm execution/result states.

required_repair: Parse valid and transaction timestamps into a single chronological representation before comparing; add fractional/no-fraction reversal regressions and require transaction_time monotonicity with timeline sequence.
Cross-bind every component parent to the same logical identity and surface with an earlier generation and nonlater transaction time; reject cycles and cross-lineage parents.
Require each experiment target_surface_ids set to equal the surfaces of target_component_ids.
Cross-bind plan and proof progress to exact BASE/TRUE/SHAM completion and result receipts plus the appropriate verified decision receipt; define an explicit receipt for verified_unapplied.
For rolled_back, preserve and require the applied receipt as well as the rollback receipt, or represent the complete transition history in a separately bound receipt.
Require global deployed_verified to contain deployed_verified experiment evidence rather than runtime_verified alone, and mirror every runtime relationship in deterministic schema-oracle tests.
Clarify the timeline receipt class so not_asserted and asserted_unverified cannot inherit a receipt that can be misread as causal verification.
Freeze these counterexamples as permanent regressions, rebuild the six-file closure, and request a distinct fresh critic.
